title: 19-BCV-010 - Oil and gas processing facilities
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE))

facts.text: The variance concerns small oil-and-gas processing buildings used for equipment and classified as low-human-occupancy buildings outside urban areas; it excludes residential, office, and warehousing buildings.
A Group F, Division 2 classification is limited to a building area no greater than 150 m² and a risk assessment by an Alberta-licensed registered engineering professional.

The risk assessment and other conditions address ventilation, gas detection, emergency shutdown, fire detection/depressurization, remote firefighting water, training, procedures, exits, spatial separation, and extinguishers.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.

Historical status as of 2026-10-24: the official 2019 catalogue is marked archived/replaced by the 2023 catalogue; Alberta lists NBC(AE) 2019 as in force from 2019-12-01 through 2024-04-30.
